verdict.rationale: monday's docs describe a dedicated agent-building capability: defining goals/rules in natural language, describing workflows to create custom agents, scoping board access, hosting/sandboxing, granular permissions, and monitoring via an admin dashboard (monday-docs-13, 14, 10, 5, 6, 9). This directly matches the story of building/configuring a custom AI agent within the product.  Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that the agent builder works as described in practice, and detail on customization limits/complexity for non-technical users.
